title: A pyramid measured with a stick
back: Tradition says Thales found a pyramid's height from two shadows: similar triangles, one ratio.

title: Similar triangles
back: Equal angles and sides in the same ratio. One is an enlargement of the other.

title: Basic Proportionality Theorem
back: DE ∥ BC, so AD : DB = AE : EC. Converse: equal ratios make DE ∥ BC.

title: BPT with parts
back: Parts with parts. The converse proves lines parallel.

title: BPT with whole sides
back: Use this one whenever DE or BC is in the question.

title: Proof of BPT
back: Reason for the equal areas: same base DE, between the same parallels.

title: Three similarity tests
tex: \begin{gathered}\text{AA: two angles}\\ \text{SSS: three side ratios}\\ \text{SAS: angle + its two sides}\end{gathered}
back: AA is used most. In SAS the equal angle must lie between the proportional sides.

title: Order of the letters
back: First with first, second with second, third with third.

title: Height from a shadow
back: Same time of day, same sun angle: the two triangles are similar by AA.

title: Perimeters of similar triangles
back: Sides in the ratio 2 : 3 give perimeters in the ratio 2 : 3. (The area ratio is not in boards.)
